newestSourceAsOf.semantics: Newest official CMS source-modified date among PUBLIC metrics. Not a single network clock and not a deployment date.

combinedProviderDenominator.semantics: Sum of three distinct CMS class directories. Not unique organizations or unique companies. Not published as a headline total.

combinedEvidenceDepth.reason: A combined 'indexed senior-care evidence records' headline would mix incompatible CMS grains, including observations, citations, inspections, deficiencies, enforcement rows, staffing summaries, and CHOW events. Deficiencies are not independent of inspections. The candidate sum is reconstructable from enumerated current-release components but is not stable enough, or clear enough, to publish.

metrics.label: Current nursing homes
metrics.denominator: Current CMS Nursing Home Provider Information directory
metrics.description: Current CMS Nursing Home directory identities. Identity is CMS CCN.

trace.method: Latest provider_directory_status per CCN where directory_status='CURRENT_ACTIVE' and provider_type='nursing_home'.
limitations: Known CCNs are not added into current.
Absence from the current directory is not proof of closure.

metrics.label: Current home health agencies
metrics.denominator: Current CMS Home Health Care Agencies directory
metrics.description: Current CMS Home Health Care Agencies directory identities. Identity is CMS Home Health CCN.

limitations: An office address is not a verified service area.

metrics.label: Current hospice providers
metrics.denominator: Current CMS Hospice General Information directory
metrics.description: Current CMS Hospice General Information directory identities. Identity is CMS Hospice CCN.

trace.method: Distinct provider_id rows in hospice_snapshot (GI directory). Quality-file-only CCNs are excluded.
limitations: Evidence-only identities are not current GI providers and are not proof of closure.

metrics.label: Known nursing-home CCNs
metrics.denominator: Typed nursing_home providers in the research graph
metrics.description: Typed nursing-home CCNs regardless of current-directory status.

trace.method: count(*) FROM provider WHERE provider_type='nursing_home'.
limitations: Known CCNs are not current providers.

metrics.label: Nursing homes absent from the current directory
metrics.description: Latest directory status ABSENT_FROM_CURRENT_DIRECTORY. Not a closure finding.

trace.method: Latest provider_directory_status per CCN where directory_status='ABSENT_FROM_CURRENT_DIRECTORY'.
limitations: Absence is not termination and is not a current-provider total.

metrics.label: Typed hospice identities
metrics.description: All typed hospice identities, including quality-file-only CCNs.

trace.method: count(*) FROM provider WHERE provider_type='hospice'.
limitations: Typed identities are not the current GI directory.

metrics.label: Hospice evidence-only identities
metrics.description: Typed hospice CCNs that appear in quality files but not the current GI directory.

trace.method: Typed hospice providers minus distinct hospice_snapshot providers.
limitations: Do not promote these CCNs into the current hospice provider count.

metrics.label: MDS observations
metrics.denominator: Current CMS MDS Quality Measures release
metrics.description: Facility-measure-period MDS quality-measure observations in the current CMS release.

trace.method: count(*) FROM facility_quality_measure_observation in the current cms_source_freshness release.
limitations: An MDS observation is not an inspection and is not a provider.
Measure-period rows are not star ratings.

metrics.label: Fire citations
metrics.denominator: Current CMS Fire Safety Deficiencies release
metrics.description: Fire-safety citation rows in the current CMS Fire Safety Deficiencies release.

trace.method: count(*) FROM fire_safety_citation in the current cms_source_freshness release.
limitations: A fire citation is not a provider and is not a health deficiency.

metrics.label: Inspections
metrics.description: Inspection events in the current CMS Inspection Dates release. Not stacked historical ingest copies.

trace.method: count(*) FROM inspection_event constrained to the current cms_source_freshness release.
limitations: An inspection is not a deficiency and is not an enforcement action.
Stacked historical ingest copies are not added into this public count.

metrics.label: Health deficiencies
metrics.description: Health deficiency findings in the current CMS Health Deficiencies release.

trace.method: count(*) FROM deficiency_finding constrained to the current cms_source_freshness release.
limitations: A deficiency is not automatically an enforcement action.

metrics.label: Enforcement records
metrics.description: CMS penalty_enforcement rows in the current Penalties release, including fines and payment denials.

trace.method: count(*) FROM penalty_enforcement constrained to the current cms_source_freshness release.
limitations: Every CMS row is not a regulatory action of the same kind. Fines and payment denials stay separate grains.

metrics.label: Civil monetary penalties
metrics.description: Fine rows in the current CMS Penalties release.

trace.method: count(*) FROM penalty_enforcement WHERE penalty_type='Fine' in the current release.
limitations: A fine is not a payment denial.

metrics.label: Payment denials
metrics.denominator: Current CMS Penalties release, penalty_type='Payment Denial'
metrics.description: Payment-denial rows in the current CMS Penalties release.

trace.method: count(*) FROM penalty_enforcement WHERE penalty_type='Payment Denial' in the current release.
limitations: A payment denial is not a civil monetary penalty.

metrics.label: Staffing records
metrics.denominator: Current PBJ Daily Nurse Staffing release, quarterly summaries

trace.method: count(*) FROM pbj_staffing_quarter_summary in the current cms_source_freshness release.

findings.title: Senior care is three federal markets, not one directory
findings.summary: CMS currently lists 14,690 Nursing Homes, 12,460 Home Health agencies, and 6,669 Hospice providers in separate directories. They use different identifiers and measures.

chart.caption: Current CMS directory identities by provider class. These are not one population.

findings.whyItMatters: Families often hear “senior care” as one category. Public evidence is assembled by regulated class. Mixing the three totals would invent a market that CMS does not publish.
doesNotMean: That one class is better or safer than another.
That adding the three numbers counts unique companies or unique people.
That Assisted Living is included in these national CMS directories.

findings.title: Published CMS star coverage is not the same in every class
findings.summary: 14,562 of 14,690 (99.1%) current Nursing Homes have a CMS overall star. 8,050 of 12,460 (64.6%) current Home Health agencies have a Quality of Patient Care star. Hospice has no CMS overall star in this directory.

chart.caption: Share of the current class directory with a published CMS star of that class’s type.

series.label: Home Health Quality of Patient Care star
Hospice overall star
series.note: Not a CMS overall-star program in this directory

findings.whyItMatters: A missing star is evidence availability, not a zero. Hospice quality uses other CMS families (quality measures and CAHPS), not an overall star.
doesNotMean: That Nursing Homes are higher quality than Home Health or Hospice.
That a missing Home Health star means poor care.
That SeniorTrustHub has scored these classes.

findings.title: Ownership evidence is uneven — and UNKNOWN is not a clean history
findings.summary: CURRENT OWNED_BY evidence is on file for 12,562 of 14,690 (85.5%) Nursing Homes, 8,884 of 12,460 (71.3%) Home Health agencies, and 4,399 of 6,669 (66.0%) Hospice providers. Internal graph-edge counts are not a homepage measure. Nursing Home CHOW events exist (5,227); Home Health and Hospice CHOW files do not.

chart.caption: Share of each current directory with resolved CURRENT OWNED_BY evidence.

findings.whyItMatters: Public ownership files help families see connected organizations. Missing or UNKNOWN links mean the published graph is incomplete, not that a provider is independent or trustworthy.
doesNotMean: That a larger ownership network is better or worse care.
That UNKNOWN is a former owner or a confirmed sale.
That Home Health or Hospice have no owners — CMS does not publish class-equivalent CHOW files.

gaps: Most U.S. states do not yet have a SeniorTrustHub state-intelligence page. Florida, New Jersey, California, Texas, Washington, Arizona, Colorado, and Virginia currently have state intelligence pages.
CMS stars, staffing, inspections, and penalties are not interchangeable across Nursing Home, Home Health, and Hospice.
Internal ownership graph edges are not homepage publication measures. Missing public ownership evidence is not proof of independence.
Home Health and Hospice have no CMS CHOW event file in this research graph.
Assisted Living is state-regulated and is not a CMS national directory class.
No authoritative nationwide AHCA↔CMS File Number to CCN bridge is published. Internal candidates are not shown here.
verifyDirectly: Ask the provider who currently owns and operates the location.
Read the latest inspection packet or survey, not only a star summary.
Confirm whether Home Health or Hospice service area includes the county you care about.
If the person needs a state-licensed setting such as assisted living, check that state’s regulator — not only CMS.

askMarket.question: How many nursing homes are in my state?
askMarket.answer: Use Explore by place for the current CMS Nursing Home directory count in that jurisdiction. That count is a snapshot, not a quality score.

askMarket.question: What does a CMS star rating measure?
askMarket.answer: CMS stars are CMS ratings for a specific program. Nursing Home overall stars are not Home Health Quality of Patient Care stars, and Hospice has no overall star in this directory.

askMarket.question: How common is chain ownership?
askMarket.answer: Ownership is a research graph, not a ranking. 205,082 canonical organizations appear in the graph. Missing OWNED_BY evidence is incompleteness, not independence.

askMarket.question: What regulatory history should I review?
askMarket.answer: For Nursing Homes, CMS publishes inspection, deficiency, and penalty families separately. Home Health and Hospice do not have those same national files on this hub. Colorado CDPHE Find and Compare is a state search path, not a bulk inspection dataset.

askMarket.question: What does “no event found” mean?
askMarket.answer: No connected event in SeniorTrustHub is not a clean record. It can mean no published file, a coverage gap, or a period outside the source window.

askMarket.question: How does Florida’s research coverage differ?
askMarket.answer: Florida currently has a state intelligence page with 6,983 AHCA identities and 77,219 regulatory observations, plus CMS class counts. Published state pages have different acquired classes and search-only capabilities; federal CMS baseline does not imply state regulatory coverage.

askMarket.question: How does New Jersey’s research coverage differ?
askMarket.answer: New Jersey currently has a state intelligence page with 893 NJDOH All_LTC identities and 1,430 All_Acute identities, plus CMS class counts. All_LTC and All_Acute are not one senior-provider total.
